summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new Employee Feedback feature. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass covering POST /api/feedback (food + issue), rating/category/note validations, order-mapping (vendor_id/site_id/company_id/order_code populated from linked order), RBAC (master/vendor 403 on submit, employee 403 on inbox, vendor cannot hit /api/employee/feedback), order-ownership check (attaching someone else's order → 403), role-scoped GET /api/feedback (vendor only sees its own vendor_id), and PATCH /api/feedback/{id}/resolve. Frontend: /employee/feedback renders on mobile (390x844), no horizontal overflow; 5 emoji faces tappable; empty-rating submit shows toast without crash; food feedback with an order chip selected produced a DB doc with vendor_id/site_id/company_id and order_code populated; 'Other issue' tab category chips + note validation and success flow work; /vendor/feedback renders the mapped feedback with correct star rating, item name, order code, employee name; filter chips (all/open/food/issue) work; 'Mark resolved' PATCHes and UI updates to Resolved; /admin/feedback loads for master_admin. Seeded and cleaned up a dedicated employee, vendor, site, order (TESTUI_ prefix).

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed') on the employee dashboard root — reproducible on every employee login (fires from EmployeeDashboard render → Array.map). Unrelated to feedback code but appears whenever an employee logs in, so any employee reaching /employee/feedback via the app shell hits the runtime-error overlay first. Not seen when navigating directly to /employee/feedback via URL after login.

action_items: Fix EmployeeDashboard toFixed crash — likely an order/summary value read without null-guard in the .map(). It is not part of the feedback feature but breaks the employee shell users go through to reach /employee/feedback.
critical_code_review_comments: feedback router: comment length capped to 1000 chars but response of POST /feedback returns only {success,id} — consider echoing the created doc for optimistic UI (currently the employee inbox refresh is not wired in Feedback.js).

GET /api/feedback for site_admin/corporate_admin filters by user's site_id/company_id — food-only feedback submitted WITHOUT an order will still have the employee's site/company assigned in the doc, which is correct; but issue feedback submitted without an order also stores site_id/company_id — good. Vendor scoping is strict (vendor_id equality) which is correct.
Employee Feedback UI: fetchOrders swallows all errors silently — a 401/500 gives no user hint. Minor.
FeedbackInbox has no pagination — to_list(1000) is fine short-term but will need paging for larger tenants.
Item-name field is optional; UI derives it only from items[0] — multi-item orders will lose context. Consider storing all item names or a summary.

seed_data_creation: Test file seeds & tears down TEST_FB_* users/vendor/site/order. Manual UI test seeded TESTUI_* set which was cleaned up at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feedback feature is fully green (backend + UI). One unrelated bug found: EmployeeDashboard toFixed crash on employee login — main agent should fix in the dashboard component (not in feedback code). Regression suite for feedback lives at /app/backend/tests/test_feedback.py and is self-cleaning.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works. The dashboard toFixed crash is likely a numeric field (e.g., order total or rating) being undefined for one of the mapped items in EmployeeDashboard.js; add a defensive `(v ?? 0).toFixed(2)` inside the .map().
